How the show works
Quest XP = threat base (Trash mob 10, Grunt 20, Elite 40, Mini-boss 80, Raid boss 150) + one-third of your time estimate in minutes (estimates cap at 240). Gold is a quarter of the XP.
Accuracy bonus: +15% when the time you enter lands within 20% under or 25% over your estimate. Tapping Complete claims at your estimate: quick, but no bonus and it doesn't count toward your accuracy history. For the bonus, use ⋯ → Complete with time taken and enter the real minutes.
Streak: +5% for each consecutive day you complete a quest, up to +25%.
Damage: every morning each overdue quest hits you for 2× its threat (Trash mob 4 up to Raid boss 24 HP), growing 25% for each extra day overdue (up to 2.5×). Armor and other damage cuts count fully up to 30%, then at half value, capped at 60%. Hit 0 HP and you're knocked out: you drop a fifth of your gold and lose your streak.
Floors: each week is a new floor, explored one room per finished quest on the Floor map. From the week of Oct 12, each floor hides 3 to 6 bosses (Neighborhood, Borough, City, Province, Country, plus the Floor boss at the stairwell) in lairs off the corridor. Small ones tend to be near the entrance, but anything can turn up anywhere, and nobody tells you how many there are. Find a lair and choose: fight now, or mark it and come back later. While you're not in a fight, each quest's damage is stored as ⚡ Charge, and walking into a lair unleashes it all at once. Once you're in a fight, every quest hits that boss until it falls or you retreat. Some floors have a boss that roams instead of keeping a lair, and it finds you. Bosses are optional: they hold the loot (Bronze, Bronze, Silver, Silver, Gold, Legendary), and leaving them costs nothing. Overdue quests wound you, and heal the boss you're fighting. At 0 HP you're knocked out: streak lost, a fifth of your gold dropped.
Stats level up from the quests you assign them. Each level above 1 adds: Strength +2% boss damage (max 30%), Intelligence +1% XP (max 15%), Constitution +5 max HP (max 75), Dexterity a 2% wider accuracy window on each side (max 20%), Charisma +2% gold and more viewers (max 30%).
Loot boxes come from achievements, level-ups (Bronze, or Silver every fifth level), bosses and the shop. Contents are random: gold, potions, or gear from Common to Legendary. Duplicates turn into gold.
Gear: weapons, helmets and capes can raise XP; gloves add boss damage; boots add max HP and faster movement speed (a chance each quest moves you an extra room on the floor map and raid floor); body armor reduces overdue damage. Your best item in each slot counts, whatever your crawler wears. Rings each have their own perk, and only the ring you wear counts. Pet trinkets boost your pet's own passive while it wears one. Unique items are very rare, glow, and carry an extra effect.
Rival crawlers: crawlers from the rankings sometimes come for your loot (now and then after a quest, or from a ⚔ ambush room on the map). Each quest you finish hits them; they hit back each quest and overnight, but never knock you out on their first night. Beat one and they're knocked out for the floor (XP, gold, maybe an item they're wearing). Or bribe them, run (better boots, better odds), or walk to a shrine. If they knock you out, they steal one spare backpack item (never worn gear, never Unique) and come back for a rematch a few days later: win it to get your item back. A rare psycho won't take a bribe and only backs off for a day: that one has to be killed. Crewmates can tap Help on the Party tab to chip at your rival, but the final blow is yours.
Personal Quarters: a private room through the portal in the Safe Room, 1,500 gold (or a Deed Coupon from a Gold or Celestial box, or the weekly #1 prize). Upgrades: Bed (heal 10% max HP each morning), Kitchen (cook once a day for +5% XP until midnight), Bath (pet never sulks, +15% bond), Training Room (+10% XP on one stat, switch weekly), Crafting Studio (a workbench to salvage, craft, masterwork and fuse gear; see Crafting below), Quest Screen (+10% viewers, rematch warnings, episode replays) and Trophy Wall. Tick crewmates onto your guest list and they can visit and cook in your kitchen. Communal Hall: crewmates with quarters can each tap Conjoin to share a hall. Upgrades you own work at full strength; ones only a hallmate owns work for you at half strength (a shared kitchen feeds you +2.5% XP daily with no cooking, a shared studio lets you use the workbench at +50% material cost). On days 2+ hallmates finish a quest, everyone in the hall gets +5% XP. With 2 or more Crafting Studios in the hall (twin workshops), everyone's crafting materials cost 15% less.
Loot boxes only open somewhere safe: the Safe Room tab, your quarters or the Communal Hall. Carrying unopened boxes doubles your odds of a rival crawler jumping you, and if one knocks you out, it grabs an unopened box first. Beat it in the rematch to take the box back.
Crafting (needs a Crafting Studio in your quarters, or a hallmate's at half strength): salvage gear you aren't wearing into ⚙ Scrap, ✨ Essence and 💠 Starshards (mobs, chests, rivals, bosses and boxes drop them too); craft a chosen slot at Magic, Rare, Legendary or top-tier Legendary ✦; masterwork your gear up to ★★★ (+20% to its bonus per star). Crafting levels unlock Rare (level 2), Legendary (4) and Legendary ✦ (6) recipes and cut gold costs 5% a level. Clockwork Golems and Chore Druids gain crafting XP 50% faster. Unique gear can't be crafted, salvaged or fused.
Grind time: once every boss on a floor is down, the floor stays dangerous until the stairwell opens. Mobs jump you on about 40% of quests (a third of them packs) and pay +50% XP, and rival crawlers turn up twice as often (up to 5 a floor).
Raid boss cap: only two Raid boss quests open at once.
Party raid: each week your party shares a maze with the raid boss's lair at the center, and every quest walks you one room toward it. From the week of Oct 12, raid damage only lands in the lair. Quests on the way store half their damage as ⚡ Charge, released in one hit when you arrive, and each crewmate in the lair with you adds 10% (up to +50%). The raid boss has 1,200 HP for each party member active that week.
Repeating quests pay full XP each time, then rest until their next turn. Steps pay up to 60% of a quest's base XP as you check them off.
Pets: pick one of seven starters; three more hatch from Mystery Eggs (8% of Gold Boxes, 20% of Platinum Boxes). Your active pet gives a passive bonus that grows with bond level (1–10) plus a special ability. Every quest you finish builds bond, faster with Charisma. Go three days without finishing a quest and your pet sulks: its bonuses pause until you finish one.
Recap episodes: every boss kill gets a short recap and every floor gets a full finale, whether you clear it or the stairwell closes on you. They wait for you in the banner above the boss and the Episode guide, which keeps the last 10.
Consumables: Potions of Focus (double XP on your next quest), Scrolls of Extension (push a due date back 2 days) and Smoke Bombs (skip one occurrence of a repeating quest, chain intact). They drop from boxes and the shop sells them. Scrolls and bombs are used from a quest's ⋯ menu.
Belt hotbar: the bar at the bottom holds consumables for one-tap use (or keys 1–6 on a keyboard). Your best belt sets how many slots you get, from 1 with no belt to 6; it counts even when you're not wearing it. Tap the belt icon on the bar to choose what goes in each slot. Scrolls and Smoke Bombs ask which quest to use them on.
Quest report: finishing a quest opens a report that lists everything that happened, a line at a time. It stays until you press Continue (Show all fills in the rest at once). Achievements follow, one at a time. Missed something? The 🔔 in the top bar keeps a history of every popup and report.
Leaving bosses behind: if the stairwell closes with bosses still out there, they just stay behind. No penalty, only loot you didn't get.
Floor themes: every floor (one week) has a theme with a boon and a bane, like half-price shopping that pays less gold, or hidden boss HP with extra damage. Themes never repeat back to back, and the finale episode teases the next one.
Race & class: when Floor 3 opens you pick a race (shifts your stat levels and adds a quirk) and a class (a perk that rewards how you work). You're offered 3 of each, tilted toward your history, with one reroll per step. It's permanent.
Safe room: your first stop each day. Rest once for HP, take one bounty that must be finished today, and read your fan mail. Once per floor you can shelter for a day: the next morning's overdue damage (and boss healing) is blocked, but your quests earn no viewers that day.
Viewers go up when you get things done and down when quests rot. Each viewer milestone brings a sponsor offer: a box now, plus a 3-day contract that pays a gold bonus if you finish it or costs you gold if you miss it.
Crawler rankings: you versus invented rival crawlers, scored by boss damage this floor. Their pace scales with yours. The top 10 (from day 3) and #1 (from midweek) each pay out once per floor.
